 ☐ Colour

│ Which made-up colour scheme should the made-up
│ widget use for all of its made-up panels and
│ made-up badges?

❯ 1. Midnight Plumberry with glowing citrine edges
     and soft fogged lavender panel backgrounds
     shown throughout
     Panels use a deep plumberry base with a faint
     lavender fog. Badges glow in citrine gold.
     The scheme feels calm at night and keeps
     every made-up badge easy to spot.
  2. Seaglass Tangerine with pale mintwater panels
     and bright tangerine badges framed by
     driftwood grey
     Panels use a pale mintwater tint with thin
     driftwood grey borders. Badges pop in bright
     tangerine. The scheme feels light and sunny,
     and it suits a made-up daytime dashboard
     well.
